plants.name: Chrysanthemum × morifolium
plants.description: Dense, layered blooms in rich autumn shades cover the plants in gardens and shrines across Japan. Their petals form pom-pom, spider and shaggy shapes. Many are shown in elaborate displays at autumn festivals.
plants.bloomingSeason: Mid-autumn to early winter, peaking from October through November
plants.location: Japan, including Tokyo and Kyoto gardens
plants.funFact: Chrysanthemums have been cultivated in East Asia for more than 2,000 years. Japan's Imperial family uses a stylized chrysanthemum as its crest.

plants.name: Jacaranda mimosifolia
plants.description: Whole trees turn lilac-blue as clusters of trumpet-shaped flowers open. Fallen petals carpet streets and lawns in purple. It is one of the great spring sights of the Southern Hemisphere.
plants.bloomingSeason: Late spring, roughly October to November, in the Southern Hemisphere
plants.location: Brisbane and Sydney, Australia; Pretoria, South Africa; Buenos Aires, Argentina
plants.funFact: The tree is native to South America but is now planted in warm regions worldwide. In Pretoria it is so common that the city is nicknamed the Jacaranda City.
